en: Title: The Dhāraṇī of the Thousand Revolutions Source: Hidas & Szántó, 84000 Tibetan: D 710 [=930]

Homage to the Three Jewels! Homage to the noble Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Avalokiteśvara, the Greatly Compassionate One! It is as follows: Oṃ jaye jaye mahājaye jayavāhini jayottari kala kala mala mala cala cala hulu hulu chiṇi chiṇi! O Blessed One, [you who remove] all karmic obscurations for me, O Thousand-Turner, O Beholder of All Buddhas, O Purifier of the consciousnesses of the eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, and mind! It is as follows: Oṃ suru suru prasuru prasuru bhara bhara sambhara sambhara hara hara smara smara! Oṃ, empowered by all Buddhas, svāhā! Oṃ, beholder of all Buddhas, svāhā! Oṃ, womb of the dharma-realm, svāhā! Oṃ, awakener of the dharmas whose intrinsic nature is non-existence, svāhā! This is the ritual application of this dhāraṇī: Karmic obscurations accumulated over a thousand eons are completely destroyed by reciting it even once. One plants roots of merit equal to those planted by a thousand Buddhas. Through the transition of births, one obtains the sovereignty of a universal monarch (cakravartin) a hundred thousand times. At the time of death, one beholds a thousand Buddhas. Reciting the Thousand-Turner daily, one attains the rank of a Bodhisattva in twenty-one days. One is reborn in purified Buddha-fields. One should recite it three times at night and three times during the day. One sees desired dreams; one beholds the Golden-Colored Tathāgata. Immeasurable benefits are heard and seen in the songs of the Bodhisattvas. This should be kept constantly and continuously in mind. The Noble Dhāraṇī of the Thousand-Turner is complete.
